# Moontuner

> A lunar alignment system for tracking intention, energy, and momentum through the Moon's cycles. Reflective, non-deterministic — align with natural rhythms, not predictions.

Moontuner is a framework for energetic accountability and self-sovereignty built around the 8 lunar phases and 12 zodiac signs (96 configurations). It pairs an astronomical engine (live phase, sign, void-of-course, aspects) with reflective tooling: daily directives, a 14-day Phasecraft arc, the Chaperone workbook series, and the Lunar Cipher.

## Start here

- [Start Here](/start): The four ways into Moontuner — Phasecraft, the Lunar Chaperone, the Astro-Harmonic Symphony, and the Lunar Map & Cazimi reports.
- [For readers of PHASECRAFT](/book): The live companion to the book PHASECRAFT: The Moontuner Method.
- [Phasecraft](/phasecraft): Tonight's phase-and-sign signature, the 96 matrix, a lunar calendar, and lunar science. Each of the ninety-six has its own page at /phasecraft/signature/{sign}-{phase}, e.g. /phasecraft/signature/10-2 (Waxing Crescent in Capricorn), with the text of Appendix A of the book.
- [Phasecraft School](/school): Learn the method in six modules; lessons and progress at /school/portal.
- [Lunar Chaperone](/lunar-chaperone): Twenty-four half-moon workbooks in one continuous loop, opening on the half-cycle overhead now.
- [Astro-Harmonic Symphony](/quantumelodic): A birth chart composed as music, with narrated reading and PDF.
- [Personal Lunar Map](/lunar-reports): 12-month lunar arc, power days, and natal signature.
- [Cazimi Punchcard](/cazimi): Each year's exact solar returns to every natal placement — brief windows of renewal.
